title.en: Republicans could abandon $1bn proposal for Trump’s ballroom – US politics live
title.zh: 共和党人可能放弃为特朗普宴会厅提供10亿美元的提案——美国政治直播

summary.en: Republican senators have raised concerns about a $1 billion proposal to fund a ballroom for former President Trump, questioning its timing and the lack of detailed information in a bid to add the money to a Department of Homeland Security bill.
summary.zh: 共和党参议员对一项为前总统特朗普的宴会厅提供10亿美元资金的提案表示担忧，质疑其时机以及在试图将这笔资金添加到国土安全部法案中时缺乏细节。

body.en: Republican senators have queried the timing and lack of detail in secret service bid to add money to the Department for Homeland security bill Sign up for the Breaking News US email The supreme court will hand down opinions at 10am ET today. Here’s a reminder of the major cases we’re tracking closely. Trump v Cook: Donald Trump’s case for firing Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook, as he continues to exert greater control over the US central bank. Trump v Slaughter: A case which examines the legality of Trump’s firing of a Federal Trade Commission (FTC) member, Rebecca Slaughter. Trump v Barbara: In which the court will decide if the administration’s attempts to restrict birthright citizenship are unconstitutional. Continue reading...
body.zh: 共和党参议员对特勤局为国土安全部法案增加资金的时机和缺乏细节提出质疑。最高法院将于美国东部时间今天上午 10 点发表意见。以下是我们正在密切跟踪的重大案件的提醒。特朗普诉库克：唐纳德·特朗普解雇美联储理事丽莎·库克的理由是，他继续对美联储施加更大的控制。特朗普诉斯劳特：此案审查特朗普解雇联邦贸易委员会 (FTC) 成员丽贝卡·斯劳特的合法性。特朗普诉芭芭拉：法院将决定政府限制出生公民权的尝试是否违宪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: When public funds are involved, integrity and transparency are paramount, reflecting the principle of being trustworthy with what is entrusted to us. The questioning of a significant spending proposal highlights the ongoing need for leaders to be faithful stewards, whether with a little or with much. This vigilance helps ensure that resources are managed...
reflection.zh: 当涉及公共资金时，诚信和透明度至关重要，这反映了对所托付之事忠心负责的原则。对一项重大支出提案的质疑，凸显了领导者无论在小事还是大事上，都需要持续成为忠心的管家。这种警惕有助于确保资源得到负责任的管理，并服务于共同利益。

verse.textEn: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much, and whoever is dishonest with very little will also be dishonest with much.
verse.textZh: 人在最小的事上忠心，在大事上也忠心；在最小的事上不义，在大事上也不义。

title.en: Polanski defends Greens fielding byelection candidate against Burnham – UK politics live
title.zh: 官方数据显示，2025年英国净移民人数几乎减半

summary.en: Official figures show that net migration into the UK almost halved in 2025, reaching 171,000, the lowest since 2021. The Home Office also reported that 20,885 asylum seekers were temporarily housed in hotels.
summary.zh: 官方数据显示，2025年英国净移民人数几乎减半，达到17.1万人，为2021年以来的最低水平。内政部还报告称，截至目前，有20,885名寻求庇护者暂时安置在酒店中。

body.en: The Green leader said that ‘people must have the choice to vote for the candidate of their choice’. The Home Office has also published asylum figures this morning. These show that the number of asylum seekers being housed temporarily in hotels stood at 20,885 at the end of March 2026, down 35% year-on-year from 32,326. The Press Association says: It is the lowest figure since data was first reported in 2022, Home Office figures show. The total had climbed as high as 56,018 at the end of September 2023. Brits are leaving on a massive scale and non-EU immigration remains far too high. Mass immigration undermines our society and low wage immigration is bad for the economy. British families feel it in lower wages, longer waiting lists for public services and housing shortages. Labour must go further and reform indefinite leave to remain before their hard-left flank forces them to abandon it altogether. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国国家统计局表示，截至 2025 年 12 月的这一数字为 171,000 人，是 2021 年以来的最低水平。内政部今天上午也公布了庇护数据。这些数据显示，截至2026年3月，临时安置在酒店的寻求庇护者人数为20,885人，比去年同期的32,326人减少了35%。新闻协会表示：内政部数据显示，这是自 2022 年首次报告数据以来的最低数字。截至 2023 年 9 月底，总数已攀升至 56,018 人。英国人正在大规模离开，非欧盟移民人数仍然过高。大规模移民破坏我们的社会，低工资移民不利于经济。英国家庭在工资较低、公共服务等候名单较长以及住房短缺等方面感受到了这一点。工党必须进一步改革无限期居留权，以免他们的极左翼迫使他们完全放弃这一政策。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As nations grapple with migration figures and policies, the underlying call remains to consider how we treat those who seek a new home among us. Leviticus 19:33-34 reminds us to welcome foreigners as if they were native-born, remembering our shared human experience. This principle encourages compassion and fair treatment for all who reside in our land.
reflection.zh: 当各国都在处理移民数据和政策时，其核心呼召仍然是思考我们如何对待那些在我们中间寻求新家园的人。利未记19:33-34提醒我们，雅伟神命令我们要像对待本地人一样欢迎寄居的外国人，并记住我们共同的人类经历。这一原则鼓励我们对所有居住在我们土地上的人抱有怜悯和公平的对待。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Dozens of vehicles burnt as Mali jihadists enforce blockade
title.zh: 马里圣战分子实施封锁，数十辆车辆被烧毁

summary.en: Jihadists in Mali have enforced a blockade, burning dozens of vehicles. Mali is a landlocked country heavily reliant on fuel transported from neighboring nations, making the blockade a significant disruption.
summary.zh: 马里圣战分子实施封锁，烧毁了数十辆车辆。马里是一个内陆国家，严重依赖从邻国运输的燃料，因此此次封锁造成了重大干扰。

body.en:
Dozens of vehicles, including fuel tankers, minibuses and trucks, have been set on fire near Mali's capital, Bamako, as jihadists step up a blockade of the city, the BBC has confirmed.

Videos filmed from passing vehicles and verified by the BBC show the charred remains of the vehicles on a road about 45km (28 miles) west of Bamako. There are no reports of casualties - those on board were said to have been asked to get out before the vehicles were burnt.

Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM), a jihadist group affiliated to al-Qaeda, imposed a fuel blockade on Bamako last year, which it tightened after attacking the city last month.

Mali is a landlocked country and depends heavily on fuel transported from neighbouring coastal countries like Senegal and Ivory Coast.

The militants have kidnapped drivers and burnt more than 100 fuel trucks on major highways in the country since last year, but some have made it to Bamako under military escort.

In the latest attack, BBC Verify authenticated the videos through matching two distinctive buildings on the side of the road to satellite imagery and checking for AI manipulation.

Nasa's satellite-based platform Firms - which detects heat sources on Earth's surface – also detected a heat signature at the same location on Tuesday.

The fuel blockade is intended to suffocate Mali's economy and weaken the legitimacy of the military leaders in power, experts say.

Mali is currently led by Gen Assimi Goïta, who first seized power in a coup in 2020, promising to restore security and push back the armed groups.

In January, he appointed 47-year-old Brig Gen Famouké Camara to head a special operation to counter the fuel blockade, but attacks on fuel convoys have continued.

Before the latest attack, the fuel crisis resulting from the blockade had appeared to be easing.

When the jihadists imposed a fuel blockade last year, it caused shortages and a sharp increase in prices in the capital.

Eyewitnesses told the BBC at the time that at least three of the six main routes into the city would be closed for hours at a time, and while the fighters moved elsewhere, some vehicles would manage to slowly get through.

One man said that a kilo of potatoes that used to be 350 francs ($0.62; £0.46) now cost 500 ($0.90).

Ahead of the Islamic holiday of Eid al-Adha, which is next week, there are often lots of sheep being sold on the streets of the capital of the Muslim-majority country - but it is not the case this year.

Muslims are supposed to slaughter an animal to commemorate the willingness of Prophet Ibrahim to sacrifice his son Ishmael as an act of obedience to God's command.

Every Muslim family in Mali tries to buy an animal to slaughter for Eid, but this year, the blockade means it has been difficult to transport...
body.zh: 英国广播公司证实，随着圣战分子加强对马里首都巴马科的封锁，包括油罐车、小巴和卡车在内的数十辆车辆在马里首都巴马科附近被纵火。 从过往车辆拍摄并经 BBC 核实的视频显示，巴马科以西约 45 公里（28 英里）的道路上有车辆烧焦的残骸。目前还没有人员伤亡的报道——据说车上的人被要求在车辆被烧毁之前撤离。 隶属于基地组织的圣战组织 Jama'at Nusrat al-Islam wal-Muslimin (JNIM) 去年对巴马科实施了燃料封锁，并在上个月袭击该市后加强了封锁。 马里是一个内陆国家，严重依赖从塞内加尔和科特迪瓦等邻国沿海国家运输的燃料。 自去年以来，武装分子在该国主要高速公路上绑架了司机并焚烧了 100 多辆加油车，但其中一些武装分子在军队护送下抵达巴马科。 在最新的攻击中，BBC verify 通过将路边两座独特的建筑与卫星图像进行匹配并检查人工智能操纵来验证视频的真实性。 美国宇航局的卫星平台Firms——用于探测地球表面的热源——周二也在同一地点探测到了热信号。 专家表示，燃料封锁的目的是扼杀马里经济并削弱当权军事领导人的合法性。 马里目前由阿西米·戈伊塔将军领导，他在 2020 年的政变中首次夺取政权，承诺恢复安全并击退武装团体。 一月份，他任命 47 岁的法穆克·卡马拉准将领导一项特别行动，应对燃料封锁，但针对燃料车队的袭击仍在继续。 在最近一次袭击之前，封锁造成的燃料危机似乎正在缓解。 去年，圣战分子实施燃料封锁，导致首都出现燃料短缺和物价急剧上涨。 目击者当时告诉 BBC，进入该市的 6 条主要道路中至少有 3 条将被关闭数小时，而当武装分子转移到其他地方时，一些车辆将设法缓慢通过。 一名男子表示，一公斤土豆过去售价 350 法郎（0.62 美元；0.46 英镑），现在售价 500 法郎（0.90 美元）。 在下周的伊斯兰节日古尔邦节之前，这个穆斯林占多数的国家首都的街道上经常有大量的羊被出售，但今年的情况并非如此。 穆斯林应该宰杀一只动物来纪念先知易卜拉欣愿意牺牲他的儿子以实玛利作为对真主命令的服从。 马里的每个穆斯林家庭都试图购买动物来庆祝开斋节，但今年的封锁意味着运输变得困难......

reflection.en: The blockade in Mali, marked by the burning of essential transport, highlights the devastating impact of unchecked power on vulnerable communities. When those in power act with cruelty, ordinary people suffer from the disruption of basic necessities.
reflection.zh: 马里发生的封锁，以及数十辆重要运输车辆被烧毁，凸显了不受约束的权力对弱势社区造成的破坏性影响。当掌权者残暴行事时，普通民众就会因基本生活必需品中断而遭受苦难。

verse.textEn: Like a roaring lion or a charging bear is a wicked ruler over a helpless people.
verse.textZh: 暴虐的君王辖制贫民，好像吼叫的狮子、觅食的熊。

title.en: Many Nato countries not spending enough to support Ukraine, says Rutte – Europe live
title.zh: 捷克总统彼得·帕维尔警告：‘欧洲和平不再是默认状态’

summary.en: European state officials are meeting in Prague for a global security conference, where Czech President Petr Pavel warned that peace in Europe can no longer be taken for granted. This comes as a Russian foreign ministry spokesperson also made statements regarding Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
summary.zh: 欧洲各国官员正在布拉格举行全球安全会议，捷克总统彼得·帕维尔在会上警告称，欧洲的和平不再是理所当然的默认状态。与此同时，俄罗斯外交部发言人也对乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基发表了言论。

body.en: Nato chief delivers speech in Sweden as he hints at further changes to US military commitments to Europe Just as Pavel was speaking in Prague, Russian foreign ministry spokesperson Maria Zakharova told reporters that Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy was pursuing escalation of the conflict between the two countries. It’s quite a claim given (checks notes) Russia’s continued and relentless invasion of Ukraine for years. “ Ukraine has demonstrated not only determination and heroism, but also unbelievable capacity to adjust, to innovate, to change. It is something that we in Europe have lost through many regulatory measures that are necessary in peacetime, but of course in conflict you have to be … flexible and achieve the results in shortest possible time. … Continue reading...
body.zh: 欧洲国家官员正在布拉格举行全球安全会议，讨论跨大西洋联盟的状况。就在帕维尔在布拉格发表讲话时，俄罗斯外交部发言人玛丽亚·扎哈罗娃告诉记者，乌克兰总统泽连斯基正在寻求升级两国之间的冲突。考虑到俄罗斯多年来对乌克兰持续无情的入侵，这是一个相当有说服力的说法（检查笔记）。 “乌克兰不仅表现出了决心和英雄主义，而且还表现出了令人难以置信的调整、创新和变革的能力。这是我们欧洲人通过和平时期必要的许多监管措施而失去的东西，但当然在冲突中你必须……灵活并在尽可能短的时间内取得成果。……继续阅读...

reflection.en: The warning that peace is no longer a default situation reminds us that harmony often requires intentional effort and vigilance. In a world of complex tensions, we are called to actively pursue peace wherever and whenever possible.
reflection.zh: 和平不再是默认状态的警告提醒我们，和谐常常需要刻意的努力和警惕。在一个充满复杂张力的世界里，我们蒙召在任何可能的情况下积极追求和平。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: DR Congo cancels World Cup training camp over Ebola outbreak
title.zh: 刚果民主共和国因埃博拉疫情取消世界杯训练营

summary.en: An Ebola outbreak, caused by a rare species, has led to the cancellation of a World Cup training camp in DR Congo. The disease is reported to have caused 139 deaths so far.
summary.zh: 刚果民主共和国因一种罕见的埃博拉病毒爆发而取消了世界杯训练营。据报道，此次疫情已导致139人死亡。

body.en:
The Democratic Republic of Congo has cancelled its pre-World Cup training camp in the capital, Kinshasa, because of an Ebola outbreak in the east of the country.

Preparations have been moved to Belgium amid the upsurge, which is thought to have killed more than 130 people.

The World Health Organization (WHO) has called the outbreak a "public health emergency of international concern", but said it was not at pandemic level.

Jerry Kalemo, a spokesperson for the national football team, told international media that pre-tournament games in Europe would go ahead as planned, as the squad gears up for their first World Cup since 1974.

DR Congo are due to play friendly matches against Denmark, on 3 June in Belgium, and Chile, on 9 June in Spain, ahead of the World Cup finals.

They play their first match of the tournament in the US city of Houston on 17 June against Portugal.

"Originally scheduled to take place in the capital on May 26, the Leopards' public training session will not be held after all. This decision follows reports of suspected Ebola cases in the provinces of North Kivu and Ituri," a message posted by the team on social media said.

There is also uncertainty over whether the team's French coach, Sébastien Desabre, will go ahead with a press conference scheduled to take place in the capital city, the statement added.

A spokesperson for the DR Congo team told the Reuters news agency that the training camp had been cancelled due to travel restrictions imposed by the US, who are hosting the World Cup this summer, along with Mexico and Canada.

The US' public health agency has banned entry from non-Americans who have been in the DR Congo, Uganda or South Sudan in the previous 21 days, in response to the Ebola outbreak.

All DR Congo's players are based outside the central African country and will therefore not be affected by the restrictions now the training camp has been cancelled.

Some team staff based in DR Congo left the country on Wednesday, Kalemo told the Associated Press, ahead of the 21-day deadline.

However, some fans and journalists, who applied for US visas via the Congolese ministry of sport, are concerned because the US embassy in DR Congo has paused its visa services in light of the Ebola outbreak.

A sports reporter from the national broadcaster questioned why they should be stopped from attending the World Cup when there have not yet been any reported Ebola cases where they are based, in Kinshasa.

Kinshasa is roughly 1,800 km (1,120m) away from the eastern Ituri province, the epicentre of the outbreak.

Michel Nkuka Mbolandinga, a supporter who has gained prominence for impersonating former Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba , told the BBC: "I am confident that I will be travelling, but I don't know how far the ministry is...
body.zh: 由于该国东部爆发埃博拉疫情，刚果民主共和国取消了在首都金沙萨举行的世界杯前训练营。 抗议活动已造成 130 多人死亡，准备工作已转移至比利时。 世界卫生组织（WHO）称此次疫情为“国际关注的突发公共卫生事件”，但表示尚未达到大流行的程度。 国家足球队发言人杰里·卡莱莫告诉国际媒体，欧洲赛前比赛将按计划进行，球队正在为自 1974 年以来的首次世界杯做准备。 在世界杯决赛之前，刚果民主共和国将于 6 月 3 日在比利时与丹麦进行友谊赛，并于 6 月 9 日在西班牙与智利进行友谊赛。 刚果民主共和国队的发言人告诉路透社，由于今年夏天主办世界杯的美国、墨西哥和加拿大实施旅行限制，该队的训练营已被取消。 为了应对埃博拉疫情，美国公共卫生机构已禁止过去 21 天内去过刚果民主共和国、乌干达或南苏丹的非美国人入境。 刚果民主共和国的所有球员以及球队的法国教练塞巴斯蒂安·德萨布雷都居住在刚果民主共和国以外的国家，因此不会受到训练营取消后的限制的影响。 据路透社报道，这场在金沙萨举行的备受瞩目的活动原本应该有球迷参加，包括刚果民主共和国总统菲利克斯·齐塞克迪。 金沙萨距埃博拉疫情中心东部伊图里省约 1,800 公里（1,120m）。该市尚未报告任何病例。 周三，世界卫生组织表示，600 例疑似病例中，有 139 人被认为死亡。然而，同一天，刚果卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴 (Samuel Roger Kamba) 告诉国家广播公司 RTNC TV，当局已登记 159 人死亡。 此次疫情是由一种名为本迪布焦（Bundibugyo）的稀有埃博拉病毒引起的。目前还没有针对该物种的疫苗，世界卫生组织表示，可能需要长达九个月的时间才能准备好疫苗。

reflection.en: The news of an Ebola outbreak and its tragic toll reminds us of life's fragility and the pervasive presence of illness in our world. In such times, we are called to remember those afflicted and to lift them in prayer, trusting in God's compassion and healing power.
reflection.zh: 埃博拉疫情爆发及其悲惨的死亡人数提醒我们生命的脆弱，以及疾病在我们世界中普遍存在。在这样的时刻，我们被呼召记念那些受苦的人，并为他们祷告，信靠雅伟的怜悯和医治大能。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: US curbs on travelers exposed to deadly viruses may infringe rights and deter volunteers
title.zh: 美国对接触致命病毒的旅行者实施限制，或侵犯权利并阻碍志愿者

summary.en: The US is imposing strict restrictions on American travelers exposed to Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks, measures that experts suggest may infringe on individual rights and deter volunteers.
summary.zh: 美国正在对接触过埃博拉病毒和汉坦病毒疫情的美国旅行者实施严格限制，专家认为这些措施可能侵犯个人权利并阻碍志愿者。

body.en: Strict restrictions on Americans with exposure to Ebola and hantavirus highlight officials’ previous rhetoric on public health measures The US is imposing strict restrictions on American travelers who have been exposed in dual Ebola and hantavirus outbreaks in ways that experts say could run counter to their legal rights and affect who will volunteer in future public health crises globally. The latest restrictions highlight officials’ previous rhetoric on public health measures and their attempts to contain outbreaks now, including reported opposition from the White House to Americans returning home. title.en: Gaza flotilla activists set for deportation from Israel as backlash over treatment grows
title.zh: 加沙船队活动人士在以色列被拘留后将遭驱逐出境，对其待遇的强烈反弹日益加剧

body.en:
Hundreds of pro-Palestinian activists who were detained in Israel after their flotilla bringing symbolic aid to Gaza was intercepted are set to be deported from the country.

It follows international backlash in response to a video posted by far-right National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir showing himself taunting activists kneeling with their hands tied behind their backs.

On Thursday, the UK confirmed it had summoned Israel's top diplomat in Britain, charge d'affaires Daniela Grudsky Ekstein, over the incident.

In a statement, the UK Foreign Office said the move reflected the UK's "strong condemnation of [Ben Gvir's] conduct in taunting those involved in the Global Sumud Flotilla".

"We are also deeply concerned by the detention conditions depicted and have demanded an explanation from the Israeli authorities. We made clear their obligations to protect the rights of all those involved," the statement said.

There has also been condemnation from the US, France, Italy and Canada, and Ireland.

On Thursday, Italian politician Dario Carotenuto and journalist Alessandro Mantovani, who were part of the flotilla, were pictured arriving at Rome Fiumicino Leonardo da Vinci International Airport, after first being flown to Athens.

Speaking to reporters, Carotenuto said they had been beaten after arriving in Israel.

Adalah, an Israel-based rights group representing the detainees, earlier said there had been "severe, widespread injuries", with at least three people taken to hospital for treatment.

Turkey's Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said his country was conducting special flights that would bring Turkish citizens as well as third country participants to Turkey.

Spain's foreign minister said its diplomats in Israel had been informed that some 44 Spanish flotilla members would depart from Israel at 15:00 local time (12:00 BST).

Ireland's Minister for Foreign Affairs, Helen McEntee, said 15 Irish citizens who had been detained were expected to be flown to Turkey.

More than 50 boats taking part in the Global Sumud Flotilla (GSF) set sail from Turkey last Thursday carrying a token amount of aid. Four hundred and thirty people from more than 40 countries were on board.

On Monday morning, armed Israeli naval commandos began intercepting the fleet in international waters west of Cyprus, about 250 nautical miles (460km) from the coast of Gaza, which is under an Israeli maritime blockade.

Clare Azzougarh told BBC Radio 4's Today Programme her father Malcolm Ducker, who is in his early 70s, was one of the British citizens detained and she had no information on what was happening.

"We know they've been taken to Ketziot prison but otherwise we're completely in the dark."

title.en: Air France and Airbus found guilty of manslaughter over 2009 plane crash
title.zh: 法航和空客因2009年飞机失事被判过失杀人罪

summary.en: The companies were found guilty by a French court over an air disaster which killed 228 people.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Air France and Airbus have been found guilty of manslaughter over a 2009 plane crash which killed 228 people.

The Paris Appeals Court found the airline and aircraft manufacturer guilty of corporate manslaughter over the incident, in which flight AF447 between Rio de Janeiro and Paris crashed into the Atlantic Ocean.

The passenger jet stalled during a storm and plunged into the water, killing all on board.

A court had previously cleared the companies in April 2023 but they were found guilty after this appeal.

The Airbus A330 vanished from radars during a storm on 1 June 2009, with its wreckage found after a long search of 10,000 sq km (3,860 sq miles) of sea floor.

All 12 crew members and 216 passengers on board the flight were killed when the plane crashed into the sea from a height of 38,000ft (11,580m), making it the deadliest incident in French aviation history.

Relatives of some of the passengers, which included mainly French, Brazilian and German nationals, gathered to hear the verdict on Thursday.

The companies have been asked to pay the maximum fine, €225,000 ($261,720; £194,500) each - but some of the victims' families have criticised the amount as a token penalty.

However, the ruling may be seen as causing damage to the companies' reputations.

During their closing arguments in November, the deputy prosecutors said the companies' behaviour had been "unacceptable", accusing them of "spouting nonsense and pulling arguments out of thin air".

Both Airbus and Air France had repeatedly denied the charges, and French lawyers believe they are likely to launch further appeals.

The crash led to a complex recovery operation in a remote part of the Atlantic Ocean, more than 700 miles (1127km) from the coast of South America.

During the initial searches, the French government had been responsible for investigating the crash and Brazilian forces took charge of retrieving the bodies.

In the first 26 days of searches, 51 bodies were recovered, many still buckled into their seats.

One family member who spoke to BBC News Brasil in 2019 said he had only been able to bury his son's remains over two years after the incident.

His son, 40-year-old engineer Nelson Marinho Filho, nearly missed the flight out of Rio de Janeiro's Galeão International Airport and was the last person to board, according to Air France staff.
body.zh: 法航和空中客车公司因 2009 年导致 228 人死亡的飞机失事被判犯有过失杀人罪。 巴黎上诉法院裁定这家航空公司和飞机制造商在里约热内卢和巴黎之间的 AF447 航班坠入大西洋的事件中犯有企业过失杀人罪。 这架客机在暴风雨中失速并坠入水中，机上人员全部遇难。 法院此前于 2023 年 4 月裁定这些公司无罪，但在此次上诉后被判有罪。 2009 年 6 月 1 日的一场暴风雨中，空客 A330 从雷达上消失，经过对 10,000 平方公里（3,860 平方英里）海底的长时间搜寻后，发现了其残骸。 飞机从38,000英尺（11,580m）高空坠入大海，机上12名机组人员和216名乘客全部遇难，成为法国航空史上最致命的事件。 一些乘客的亲属（主要包括法国人、巴西人和德国人）周四聚集在一起聆听判决。 这些公司被要求支付最高罚款，每家 225,000 欧元（261,720 美元；194,500 英镑），但一些受害者家属批评这一金额只是象征性的罚款。 然而，该裁决可能被视为对公司声誉造成损害。 在11月的结案陈词中，副检察官表示，这些公司的行为“不可接受”，指责它们“胡言乱语，凭空捏造论据”。 空客和法航都一再否认这些指控，法国律师相信他们可能会发起进一步上诉。 坠机事件导致在距南美洲海岸 700 多英里（1127 公里）的大西洋偏远地区进行了复杂的救援行动。 在最初的搜查过程中，法国政府负责调查坠机事件，巴西军队负责打捞尸体。 在最初 26 天的搜索中，共找到了 51 具尸体，其中许多尸体仍扣在座位上。 一名家庭成员在 2019 年接受 BBC 巴西新闻采访时表示，事件发生两年多后，他才得以埋葬儿子的遗体。 据法航工作人员称，他的儿子、40 岁的工程师 Nelson Marinho Filho 差点错过了从里约热内卢加利昂国际机场起飞的航班，并且是最后一个登机的人。

title.en: Trump says he will speak to Taiwan's president in break from protocol
title.zh: 特朗普称他将违反礼节与台湾总统通话

summary.en: It comes as the US weighs whether to proceed with a $14bn arms sales to Taiwan, which China claims as its own.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump says he will talk to Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te about a possible arms sale, in what would be a sharp departure from diplomatic tradition.

US and Taiwanese leaders have not spoken directly since 1979 - when Washington severed formal ties with Taiwan to recognise the Chinese government in Beijing.

China claims Taiwan as its territory and has not ruled out taking it by force. The US has long supported the self-ruled island and is bound by law to provide it with a means of self-defence, but has balanced this with maintaining diplomatic relations with China.

As president-elect in 2016, Trump took a phone call from Taiwan's then leader Tsai Ing-wen, angering Beijing.

President Lai, who took office in 2024, is behind one of the strongest pushes in years to strengthen the island's defence.

When asked on Wednesday if he planned to speak to Lai ahead of making a decision on US arms sales, Trump said: "I'll speak to him. I speak to everybody.. we'll work on that, the Taiwan problem."

He also hailed his relationship with China's President Xi as "amazing", on the back of a two-day summit in Beijing last week.

When asked about the potential conversation between Trump and Lai, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said on Thursday that China "firmly opposes official exchanges between the United States and Taiwan", as well as US arms sales to Taiwan.

China urges the US to "stop sending wrong signals to the separatist forces in Taiwan," the spokesperson said.

In 1979, the US passed the Taiwan Relations Act which states that the US can "provide Taiwan with arms of a defensive character" - which is why it continues to sell weapons to Taiwan.

Trump has said he has yet to decide if the sale of a $14bn (£10.4bn) arms package to Taiwan, reportedly including anti-drone equipment and air-defence missile systems, will go ahead.

According to a report by the Financial Times, Beijing is currently holding up a proposed visit by the Pentagon's top policy official, Elbridge Colby - saying it cannot approve a visit until Trump decides how he will proceed with the arms deal.

Last week, while flying back from Beijing on Air Force One after his meeting with President Xi, Trump was similarly asked about weapons sales to Taiwan, to which he said he would "make a determination over the next fairly short period".

"I have to speak to the person that right now is, you know who he is, that's running Taiwan," he said.

During Trump's visit to Beijing, China had made it clear that Taiwan was one of the biggest issues in its relationship with the US, with Xi warning of "conflict" between the two superpowers if handled poorly.

And while Trump dismissed the potential for conflict between the US and China over the island, he said Xi felt "very strongly"...
body.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将与台湾领导人赖清德讨论可能的军售事宜，这与外交传统大相径庭。 自1979年华盛顿断绝与台湾的正式关系、承认北京的中国政府以来，美国和台湾领导人就没有直接说过话。 中国声称台湾是其领土，并且不排除以武力夺取台湾的可能性。美国长期以来一直支持这个自治岛屿，并有法律义务为其提供自卫手段，但同时又与中国保持外交关系来平衡这一点。 2016年当选总统后，特朗普接到时任台湾领导人蔡英文的电话，激怒了北京。 2024 年上任的黎智英总统是多年来最强有力的推动之一，以加强该岛的防御。 周三，当被问及是否计划在就美国军售问题做出决定之前与赖清德通话时，特朗普表示：“我会与他通话。我会与所有人通话……我们将致力于解决台湾问题。” 上周在北京举行为期两天的峰会后，他还称赞他与中国国家主席习近平的关系“令人惊叹”。 当被问及特朗普和赖清德之间可能进行的对话时，中国外交部发言人周四表示，中国“坚决反对美国与台湾之间的官方往来”以及美国向台湾出售武器。 发言人表示，中方敦促美方停止向台湾分裂势力发出错误信号。 1979年，美国通过《与台湾关系法》，规定美国可以“向台湾提供防御性武器”，这就是美国继续向台湾出售武器的原因。 特朗普表示，他尚未决定是否继续向台湾出售价值 140 亿美元（104 亿英镑）的一揽子武器，据报道其中包括反无人机设备和防空导弹系统。 据英国《金融时报》报道，北京目前正在推迟五角大楼最高政策官员埃尔布里奇·科尔比的访问计划，称在特朗普决定如何推进军火交易之前，北京无法批准访问。 上周，在与习主席会面后乘坐空军一号从北京飞回时，特朗普也被问到有关向台湾出售武器的问题，他表示将“在接下来相当短的时间内做出决定”。 他说：“我必须与现在掌管台湾的人谈谈，你知道他是谁。” 在特朗普访问北京期间，中国明确表示台湾是中美关系中最大的问题之一，习近平警告称，如果处理不当，两个超级大国之间将发生“冲突”。 尽管特朗普否认美国和中国在该岛问题上发生冲突的可能性，但他表示，习近平的感觉“非常强烈”……

title.en: Is the US deepening its military involvement in Nigeria?
title.zh: 美国是否正在加深对尼日利亚的军事介入？

summary.en: Airstrikes in Nigeria led by the US have weakened the so-called Islamic State (IS) terror group. The joint operation shows an expanding US role, but analysts warn of limited long‑term impact and civilian risks.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Airstrikes in Nigeria led by the US have weakened the so-called Islamic State (IS) terror group. The joint operation shows an expanding US role, but analysts warn of limited long‑term impact and civilian risks.

Joint airstrikes by the US and Nigeria have killed at least 175 fighters of the so-called  Islamic State (IS)  terror group in Nigeria's northeast. The jihadist group's global second-in-command was among those killed, according to the US Africa Command (AFRICOM). Nigeria's President Bola Tinubu was quick to thank US President Donald Trump for his leadership and unwavering support, saying he looked forward to more such "decisive strikes against terrorist enclaves."

AFRICOM commander General Dagvin Anderson told a Congressional hearing in Washington that Nigeria had been "instrumental throughout the last several months, developing the target, helping us with the intelligence, and providing support" as per the remit of the cooperation between the two countries, which dates back almost 20 years.

However, in recent months, under the initiative of Tinubu, the US involvement in Nigeria, especially its ongoing security affairs , has increased, raising questions about the depth, scale and nature of the current arrangement.

Malik Samuel, a senior researcher at Good Governance Africa in Nigeria, regards the present US engagement critically, stressing that the presence of US troops in Nigeria was supposed to be "limited to intelligence-gathering support, [and] training, ruling out combat operations for the troops."

"But with reports, especially in the US media, saying that US troops were actually deployed for this purpose, this clearly shows that the Nigerian government has not ben transparent with regards to the exact roles that the US troops will be playing."

DW reporter Jamiu Abiodun Sulaiman says that "seeing the United States with its military might, spotlighting the Islamic State in the north, is a welcome development.

"But when you look deeper, [the mood] is kind of divided because there are still concerns because of the issue that the Nigerian government has not been transparent about its partnership with the US," Sulaiman said, conceding that "[t]he broader US-Nigeria partnership leaves more questions than answers, but a lot of people still believe that this is going to — to some extent — decimate IS in the northeast ."

According to the United Nations (UN) , more than 40,000 people have been killed and over 2 million others displaced since the Boko Haram  Islamist extremist insurgency began in 2009.

This insurgency has since evolved and now includes Boko Haram's offshoot and rival, the Islamic State West Africa Province (ISWAP) .

title.en: Thailand revives bill to clear the air of toxic smog
title.zh: 泰国重启法案以清除空气中的有毒烟雾

summary.en: Seasonal smog is a major public health problem in Thailand. Long-delayed legislation aims to stop air pollution before it starts, but enforcement could present a problem.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Seasonal smog is a major public health problem in Thailand. Long-delayed legislation aims to stop air pollution before it starts, but enforcement could present a problem.

Thailand's parliament has revived  long-delayed legislation to recognize clean air as a protected public right, a major step in a country where seasonal smog has become an annual health emergency.

Last week, lawmakers voted 611 to three to advance the Clean Air Act, which now goes to the Senate, parliament's upper chamber, for scrutiny before it can be submitted to the prime minister and the king for endorsement.

The Clean Air Bill started life as citizen-initiated legislation, first proposed by a coalition of NGOs in 2019 before being taken up by political parties and previous governments. Seven draft versions were later consolidated into a single bill.

The bill would require major emitters in industry, transport and agriculture to pay fees, fines or compensation for damage caused by pollution. It also seeks to trace supply chains, including agricultural imports, to ensure that products linked to open burning or transboundary haze do not escape scrutiny.

At present, air pollution in Thailand is governed by a patchwork of laws, and the new bill is intended to bring those fragmented rules under a more coordinated national framework, while giving local authorities more power to respond to pollution in their own areas.

Thailand's air pollution crisis is most severe during the dry season, especially from December to April, when agricultural burning, forest fires, traffic and industrial emissions combine with stagnant weather.

In 2023, around 10 million people sought medical care for pollution-related illnesses, according to environmental reporting. PM2.5, fine particulate matter small enough to enter the bloodstream though the lungs , is the main concern.

According to the World Health Organization, air pollution contributes to more than 32,000 premature deaths in Thailand each year, including illnesses affecting the heart and lungs.

The bill introduces and endorses many progressive policy instruments. It requires authorities to reallocate budgets to support clean-air management and to collect pollution taxes. It provides for local ordinances, pollution control zones and area-specific air quality standards.

The bill would also create stronger air-quality monitoring systems, integrate pollution data across agencies and empower local governments to take action when pollution exceeds safe levels.

It includes measures against open burning, stronger regulation of high-emitting sectors and provisions covering transboundary pollution from outside Thailand.

body.zh: 季节性烟雾是泰国的一个主要公共卫生问题。拖延已久的立法旨在防患于未然，但执行可能会带来问题。 泰国议会恢复了拖延已久的立法，承认清洁空气是一项受保护的公共权利，对于这个季节性雾霾已成为年度卫生紧急事件的国家来说，这是迈出的重要一步。 上周，议员们以 611 票对 3 票投票通过了《清洁空气法案》，该法案现已提交议会上议院参议院进行审查，然后才能提交给总理和国王批准。 《清洁空气法案》最初是由公民发起的立法，最初由非政府组织联盟于 2019 年提出，随后被各政党和历届政府采纳。七个草案版本后来合并为一个法案。 该法案将要求工业、交通和农业的主要排放者缴纳费用、罚款或对污染造成的损害进行赔偿。它还寻求追踪供应链，包括农产品进口，以确保与露天焚烧或跨境雾霾有关的产品不会逃脱审查。 目前，泰国的空气污染问题由多种法律管辖，新法案旨在将这些零散的规则纳入更加协调的国家框架之下，同时赋予地方当局更大的权力来应对本地区的污染。 泰国的空气污染危机在旱季最为严重，尤其是12月至4月，此时农业燃烧、森林火灾、交通和工业排放以及停滞的天气相结合。 根据环境报告，到 2023 年，约有 1000 万人因污染相关疾病寻求医疗护理。 PM2.5（小到足以通过肺部进入血液的细颗粒物）是主要问题。 据世界卫生组织称，空气污染每年导致泰国超过 32,000 人过早死亡，其中包括影响心脏和肺部的疾病。 该法案引入并认可了许多进步的政策工具。它要求当局重新分配预算以支持清洁空气管理并征收污染税。它规定了地方法令、污染控制区和特定地区的空气质量标准。 该法案还将建立更强大的空气质量监测系统，整合各机构的污染数据，并授权地方政府在污染超过安全水平时采取行动。 它包括反对露天焚烧的措施、对高排放行业加强监管以及涵盖泰国境外跨境污染的规定。 该法案还设想设立一个清洁空气基金，以支持减少污染、公共卫生应对措施和……

title.en: Australian activists detained by Israel set to be released

summary.en: News of the activists' deportation comes hours after Israel's police minister drew global controversy for a video he posted to X.

body.en:
A group of Australians taken by Israel while trying to deliver aid to Gaza are set to be released from detention.

Eleven Australians were among 400 people taking part in the Global Sumud Flotilla to Gaza before being intercepted by Israeli forces at gunpoint in international waters on Tuesday.

In a statement on Thursday night, the Australian Delegation for Global Sumud Flotilla said the Australians were being taken by bus to Ramon Airport in Israel, where they were expected to board flights bound for Istanbul, Türkiye.

Earlier, Israel's ambassador to Australia Hillel Newman said the activists were "certainly safe", had access to consular officials and would be deported following due process.

"No one is in harm's way ... the dealing with them was very sensitive," he told reporters in Canberra on Thursday.

The treatment of the activists by police officers under Israel's police minister Itamar Ben-Gvir's direction drew an international outcry and a rebuke from Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

Ben-Gvir and at least one other minister ‌in Netanyahu's government, transport chief Miri Regev, posted campaign-style videos of themselves visiting the port and lambasting the protesters, attention-grabbing antics before potential early elections in Israel.

Flotilla organisers say they aim to break Israel's blockade of Gaza by delivering humanitarian assistance, something aid bodies say is still in short supply despite a US-brokered ceasefire between Israel and Hamas in place since October 2025 that includes guarantees of increased aid.

The flotilla departed from southern Türkiye this week before being intercepted on Wednesday.

Past flotillas — including one carrying Swedish activist Greta Thunberg — were also ‌intercepted by Israel, with participants ‌later deported.

In a statement, Israeli ⁠rights group Adalah said the estimated 430 activists had been released from prison in southern Israel and would be deported on Thursday via the Ramon airport near Eilat on the Red Sea.

Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said his country was conducting special flights that'd bring Turkish citizens as well as third-country participants to Türkiye.

Those on board the flotilla included citizens of Spain, South Korea and Ireland.

"We will continue to uphold the rights of our citizens and fulfil our humanitarian responsibility toward civilians in Gaza," Fidan said.

Spain's foreign minister said its diplomats in Israel had been informed that some 44 Spanish flotilla members would depart from Israel in the mid-afternoon.

title.en: 'Great triangle reversed': Xi met Trump, then Putin. It showed the world could be shifting
title.zh: “大三角”逆转：习近平会见特朗普，然后是普京。这表明世界可能正在发生转变

summary.en: The Chinese president held meetings with two global leaders, one focused on economic agreements and the other on geopolitical tensions, indicating a potential shift in international dynamics.
summary.zh: 中国国家主席与两位全球领导人举行了会晤，其中一次会议侧重于经济协议，另一次则聚焦于地缘政治对抗，这预示着国际格局可能正在发生转变。

body.en:
Peking duck, Chinese opera and Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake — this was Chinese leader Xi Jinping's grand welcome for his "old friend", Russian President Vladimir Putin.

"Not seeing you for one day feels like being apart for three autumns," Putin told Xi, a saying from one of China's oldest poetry collections, as they met in Beijing.

The friendly exchange took place in the Great Hall of the People, an imposing building on Tiananmen Square that houses China's legislature, the same spot where United States President Donald Trump stood less than a week ago .

The timing of the back-to-back meetings might have been coincidental, as Trump postponed an earlier summit in March to stay in the US during the war in Iran.

"These two visits reveal a deeper structural shift in global politics," Alexander Korolev, senior lecturer in politics and international relations at UNSW Sydney, told SBS News.

"China, I think, is increasingly becoming the central node ... We can call it a great triangle reversed, or we can probably call it a great triangle with Chinese characteristics.

"During the Cold War, the United States was the apex of the great triangle, but now it is flipped, and China is sitting at the top of the triangle," he said.

"It's not that China is trying to put Washington and Moscow against each other, but it's increasingly positioning itself as the centre of the system, the place where major power diplomacy must pass."

Putin's meeting with Xi did not go entirely as the Russians would likely have hoped, as he failed to secure a deal for the Power of Siberia 2 pipeline, which will transport gas from Siberia to China if it goes ahead.

Russian officials said both sides had reached a "general understanding on the parameters" of the project.

The leaders also issued a joint statement, outlining plans to expand collaboration across various fields, from artificial intelligence to the conservation of rare species such as tigers, leopards, and pandas.

Edward Chan, a postdoctoral fellow of China Studies at the Australian National University, said the meeting "is likely to underscore continuity in the China–Russia relationship".

"Xi wanted to remain committed to its partnership with Putin. This was reflected in the joint statement, which continued to emphasise the China–Russia comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination," he told SBS News.

"In that sense, the meeting was seen more as a reaffirmation of the China–Russia relationship amid the US–China stabilised great power relationship."

Xi and Putin also criticised Trump's Golden Dome missile defence shield — a space-based missile interceptor system.

The criticism came almost a week after Trump described Xi as a "great leader" and said it was an "honour" to be...
body.zh: 北京烤鸭、中国戏曲、柴可夫斯基的《天鹅湖》——这是中国领导人习近平对“老朋友”俄罗斯总统普京的隆重欢迎。 普京在北京会面时对习近平说：“一日不见，犹如三秋别离。”这是中国最古老的诗集之一中的一句话。 这次友好交流是在人民大会堂举行的，这是一座位于天安门广场上的宏伟建筑，是中国立法机关的所在地，不到一周前，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普也曾站过这里。 连续举行会议的时间可能纯属巧合，因为特朗普推迟了三月份的峰会，以便在伊朗战争期间留在美国。 “这两次访问揭示了全球政治更深层次的结构性转变，”悉尼新南威尔士大学政治和国际关系高级讲师亚历山大·科罗廖夫告诉SBS新闻。 “我认为，中国正在日益成为中心节点……我们可以称之为倒转大三角，也可以称之为具有中国特色的大三角。 他说：“冷战期间，美国是大三角的顶点，但现在它翻转了，中国坐在三角的顶端。” “中国并不是试图让华盛顿和莫斯科相互对立，而是越来越将自己定位为体系的中心，是大国外交的必经之地。” 普京与习近平的会晤并没有完全像俄罗斯人希望的那样进行，因为他未能就西伯利亚力量2号管道达成协议，该管道如果顺利进行，将把天然气从西伯利亚输送到中国。 俄罗斯官员表示，双方已就该项目的“参数达成总体谅解”。 领导人还发表了联合声明，概述了扩大各个领域合作的计划，从人工智能到保护老虎、豹子和熊猫等稀有物种。 澳大利亚国立大学中国研究博士后研究员爱德华·陈表示，这次会议“可能会强调中俄关系的连续性”。 “习近平希望继续致力于与普京的伙伴关系。这在联合声明中得到了体现，联合声明继续强调中俄全面战略协作伙伴关系，”他告诉SBS新闻。 “从这个意义上说，这次会晤更多地被视为在美中稳定的大国关系中对中俄关系的重申。” 习近平和普京还批评了特朗普的金顶导弹防御系统——一种天基导弹拦截系统。 近一周前，特朗普将习近平描述为“伟大的领导人”，并表示很“荣幸”……

title.en: Australia endorses historic UN resolution for climate change accountability
title.zh: 澳大利亚支持联合国具有历史意义的气候变化问责决议

summary.en: Australia voted to endorse a UN advisory opinion on climate change accountability, despite being a major global exporter of coal and gas.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚投票支持联合国关于气候变化问责制的咨询意见，尽管该国是全球主要的煤炭和天然气出口国之一。

body.en:
Australia has voted in favour of a landmark United Nations resolution, spearheaded by its Pacific island neighbours, urging action on climate change.

The 193-member global body endorsed an advisory opinion provided by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) on Wednesday, which notably warns that the failure to curb fossil fuel production could constitute an "internationally wrongful act".

The hard-fought legal opinion from the world's top court , delivered in July 2025, was first conceived by a group of Pacific students.

The Pacific island nation of Vanuatu was the first to act in support of the opinion.

The climate-vulnerable island nation, supported by its Pacific allies, was also the first to sponsor the UN General Assembly resolution.

The resolution passed with 141 votes in favour, eight against and 28 abstentions.

Pacific Islands Students Fighting Climate Change director Vishal Prasad is one of the students who instigated the ICJ advisory opinion.

"This must be a turning point in accountability for damaging the climate," he said.

"Communities on the frontlines, like in the Pacific, have been waiting far too long and continue to pay too high a price for the actions of others."

Amanda McKenzie, chief executive of the Australia-based Climate Council, said the ruling exposes the federal government's stance on fossil fuel exports.

"While the government is ramping up renewable power, it is still giving fossil fuel giants a free ride," she said.

"Continuing to wave through massive new coal and gas projects puts our kids' future at risk and is now clearly against international law."

The nation remains a major exporter of coal and gas, despite pursuing significant domestic emissions cuts and ambitious renewables targets.

Other big fossil fuel producers, including the United States, Russia, Iran and Saudi Arabia, opposed the measure.

Australia was not among the resolution's 69 co-sponsors leading into the vote. Australia and New Zealand were the only Pacific nations missing from the list.

Australia holds a key president of negotiations role heading into the next Conference of the Parties climate change talks to be held in Türkiye, with Fiji and Tuvalu set to hold official pre-event meetings.

Low-lying Tuvalu is expected to lose 90 per cent of its land to the ocean by the end of the century due to sea level rise.

The UN General Assembly resolution formally reaffirms the ICJ's findings and urges governments to align policies with limiting global warming to 1.5C.

It also urges nations in violation to provide reparation for damage and calls for the regulation of fossil fuel companies.

For the latest from SBS News, download our app and subscribe to our newsletter .
body.zh: 澳大利亚投票赞成由其太平洋岛屿邻国牵头的一项具有里程碑意义的联合国决议，敦促采取行动应对气候变化。 这个拥有 193 个成员国的全球机构周三认可了国际法院 (ICJ) 提供的咨询意见，该意见特别警告说，未能遏制化石燃料生产可能构成“国际不法行为”。 世界最高法院于 2025 年 7 月发表的经过艰苦斗争的法律意见，最初是由一群太平洋学生提出的。 太平洋岛国瓦努阿图最先表态支持这一观点。 这个气候脆弱的岛国在其太平洋盟友的支持下，也是第一个提出联合国大会决议的国家。 该决议以 141 票赞成、8 票反对、28 票弃权获得通过。 太平洋岛屿学生应对气候变化主任维沙尔·普拉萨德（Vishal Prasad）是发起国际法院咨询意见的学生之一。 “这必定是对破坏气候的责任追究的一个转折点，”他说。 “像太平洋地区一样，前线的社区已经等待太久，并继续为其他人的行为付出过高的代价。” 澳大利亚气候委员会首席执行官阿曼达·麦肯齐表示，这一裁决暴露了联邦政府对化石燃料出口的立场。 “虽然政府正在加大可再生能源发电的力度，但它仍然在给化石燃料巨头搭便车，”她说。 “继续大规模的新煤炭和天然气项目会让我们孩子的未来面临风险，现在显然违反了国际法。” 尽管追求大幅国内减排和雄心勃勃的可再生能源目标，但该国仍然是煤炭和天然气的主要出口国。 其他大型化石燃料生产国，包括美国、俄罗斯、伊朗和沙特阿拉伯，反对这项措施。 澳大利亚并不在该决议的 69 个共同提案国之列。澳大利亚和新西兰是唯一未出现在该名单中的太平洋国家。 澳大利亚在即将于土耳其举行的下一次缔约方大会气候变化谈判中担任关键的谈判主席，斐济和图瓦卢将举行正式的会前会议。 由于海平面上升，地势低洼的图瓦卢预计到本世纪末将失去 90% 的土地。 联合国大会决议正式重申了国际法院的调查结果，并敦促各国政府调整政策，将全球变暖幅度限制在 1.5 摄氏度以内。 它还敦促违规国家提供损害赔偿，并呼吁对化石燃料公司进行监管。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

reflection.en: This news highlights the tension between economic interests and the call for environmental responsibility. Psalm 24:1 reminds us that the earth and everything in it belongs to 雅伟, inviting us to consider our role as stewards rather than ultimate owners. Our actions today have lasting impacts on the planet entrusted to our care.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻凸显了经济利益与环境责任之间的张力。诗篇24:1提醒我们，大地和其中所充满的都属于雅伟，这邀请我们思考自己作为管家而非最终所有者的角色。我们今天的行动对托付给我们的地球有着持久的影响。

verse.textEn: The earth is Yahweh's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.
verse.textZh: 地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属雅伟。

title.en: Israel envoy says Ben-Gvir not reflective of country, as activist treatment condemned
title.zh: 黄英贤谴责以色列拘留活动人士的待遇“令人震惊且不可接受”

summary.en: Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong condemned the treatment of activists detained by Israel as "shocking and unacceptable." Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu also stated that the treatment of the activists by Itamar Ben-Gvir was wrong.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚外交部长黄英贤谴责以色列对待被拘留活动人士的方式“令人震惊且不可接受”。以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡也表示，伊塔马尔·本-格维尔对待这些活动人士的做法是错误的。

body.en:
Israel's ambassador to Australia, Hillel Newman, has joined growing condemnation of the actions of Israel's far-right security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir after he posted a video overnight showing detained activists from a Gaza-bound aid flotilla kneeling with their hands tied and foreheads on the ground.

The video, shared on X by Ben-Gvir, has drawn international condemnation. It was published after Israeli forces intercepted the flotilla's vessels at sea and began detaining hundreds of foreign activists at the southern port of Ashdod.

Newman told journalists Ben-Gvir's actions had been broadly condemned by the Israeli government and were not reflective of the government.

"He does not reflect the values of the state of Israel. He has been condemned by the prime minister, by the foreign minister, the entire leadership of the state of Israel.

"A country is not measured by the actions of one politician, but how the government responds to actions which are disgraceful."

Newman said that because his actions had been condemned, debate around Ben-Gvir should be put aside "and we address the real issue, which is the flotilla itself".

He repeated claims made by the Israeli government that the flotilla was a "provocation".

Earlier, Foreign Minister Penny Wong said the images of Ben-Gvir were "shocking and unacceptable".

"We condemn the actions of Israeli Minister Ben-Gvir — who Australia has sanctioned — and the degrading actions of Israeli authorities towards those detained," she said in a statement.

"I have asked Australia's Ambassador to Israel to make representations to Israel, reiterating our call for the release of the detained Australians and for Israel to ensure no ill treatment of any detainees and to act in line with international obligations."

She said Newman had been called in to the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade to "reinforce this message".

Flotilla organisers had called on Prime Minister Anthony Albanese to join international condemnation of the footage, calling on the government to summon or send home Israel's ambassador to Australia.

"We are deeply concerned for all 318 participants, the 11 courageous Australian friends and their families," the Australian delegation of the Global Sumud Flotilla said in a statement.

"There's absolutely no need or no place for it, and you know, when it comes to people who are engaged in that journey, obviously our departments tried to discourage people from going down that path, but having gone down that path, they should be treated humanely.

"I can only imagine what it's like to be a parent or a loved one of one of the people involved in that trip, and to see them treat them being treated that way, I think is deeply disappointing."

Captioned "Welcome to Israel", the footage...
body.zh: 外交部长黄英贤谴责了以色列极右翼安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔的行为，此前他隔夜发布了一段视频，显示来自加沙的船队中被拘留的活动人士双手被绑，额头着地跪着。 Ben-Gvir 在 X 上分享的这段视频引起了国际社会的谴责。这篇文章是在以色列军队在海上拦截该船队的船只并开始在南部阿什杜德港拘留数百名外国活动人士之后发表的。 她在一份声明中表示：“我们谴责以色列部长本-格维尔的行为——澳大利亚已对他实施制裁——以及以色列当局对被拘留者采取的有辱人格的行为。” “我已要求澳大利亚驻以色列大使向以色列提出交涉，再次呼吁释放被拘留的澳大利亚人，并呼吁以色列确保不虐待任何被拘留者，并按照国际义务行事。” 船队组织者呼吁总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯加入国际社会对这段视频的谴责，并呼吁政府召见或遣返以色列驻堪培拉大使。 Global Sumud 船队澳大利亚代表团在一份声明中表示：“我们对所有 318 名参与者、11 位勇敢的澳大利亚朋友及其家人深表关切。” 视频标题为“欢迎来到以色列”，视频显示数十名活动人士被迫双手被绑、额头着地跪下。有时，可以听到以色列国歌的背景音乐。 视频还显示，本-格维尔在被拘留的活动人士中质问并挥舞着以色列国旗。 美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比谴责他所说的“卑鄙行为”。 赫卡比在 X 上写道：“以色列每一位高级官员都对本·格维尔的卑鄙行为表示普遍的愤怒和谴责。舰队是愚蠢的噱头，但本·格维尔背叛了他国家的尊严。” 欧盟委员哈贾·拉赫比卜 (Hadja Lahbib) 也批评了本·格维尔 (Ben-Gvir)，他在 X 上表示，“任何人都不应该因为捍卫人类而受到惩罚”。 法国表示，已就本格维尔的“不可接受的行为”召见以色列大使，而马德里则谴责对活动人士的“可怕”待遇，并表示以色列临时代办也被召见以示抗议。 比利时因一段“令人深感不安”的视频而召见以色列大使。 加拿大总理马克·卡尼表示，“舰队上平民受到的恶劣待遇……是不可接受的”，并补充说外交部长已指示官员传唤以色列大使。 爱尔兰外交部长海伦·麦肯蒂表示，她对这段视频感到“震惊和震惊”，并要求立即释放这些活动人士，其中包括妹妹……

reflection.zh: 当掌权者承认其管辖下的人员受到不当对待时，这凸显了道德治理的至关重要性。先知耶利米提醒领袖们，他们负有神圣的使命，要秉行公义和正直，确保任何人都不受不法或暴力的对待。这一呼吁适用于所有人的待遇，特别是那些弱势或被拘留的人。

title.en: Montenegro at 20: EU ambitions and Serbian ties
title.zh: 黑山共和国20周年：欧盟雄心与塞尔维亚关系

summary.en: Twenty years after seceding from the state union with Serbia, Montenegro is seen as a Western Balkan frontrunner for EU membership but remains marked by corruption, unresolved divisions and Serbia's political influence.
summary.zh: 黑山共和国在脱离与塞尔维亚的国家联盟二十年后，被视为西巴尔干地区加入欧盟的领跑者，但仍受腐败、未解决的分歧以及塞尔维亚政治影响的困扰。

body.en:
Twenty years after seceding from the state union with Serbia, Montenegro is seen as a Western Balkan frontrunner for EU membership but remains marked by corruption, unresolved divisions and Serbia's political influence.

On May 21,  Montenegro will mark two decades since the historic referendum that paved the way for its secession from its state union with  Serbia .

The anniversary celebrations will take place in an atmosphere shaped by the country's reputation as the Western Balkans ' "high achiever" in the EU accession process.

Over the past few years, Podgorica has managed to kick-start its stalled EU accession talks, speed up reforms and position itself as the frontrunner in the region to join the EU at a time when Brussels has renewed its interest in bringing new members into the bloc.

"It's easy to be the star pupil in a classroom of bad students," Daliborka Uljarevic of the Centre for Civic Education in Podgorica told DW.

Her remark reflects the broader regional context. While much of the Western Balkans has stagnated, or even regressed, on the path toward the European Union , Montenegro has managed to capitalize on the geopolitical momentum created by Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine and the EU's renewed focus on enlargement .

Montenegro declared independence from Serbia in 2006 after a tightly contested, high-turnout referendum in which 55.5% of voters backed leaving the union with Serbia.

For the next 14 years, the country was ruled by the Democratic Party of Socialists (DPS) led by longtime strongman Milo Djukanovic.

Over the years, Djukanovic's government faced repeated accusations of corruption and links between political elites and organized crime, while critics increasingly described Montenegro as a "captured state."

The DPS eventually lost power in 2020 after months of mass protests and church-led rallies against a controversial religious property law, in what became the first democratic transfer of power since independence.

"Montenegro is one of the rare countries in the region that had enough democratic capacity to replace a man who had been in power for so long without major upheaval," said Aleksandar Popov of the Center for Regionalism in Novi Sad, Serbia. "If we look at Serbia, that will be much harder to achieve," he told DW.

Montenegro's political scene is still marked by a pro-sovereignty/pro-Serbian divide that has shaped the country since independence.

One side emphasizes a distinct Montenegrin national identity and statehood, while the other sees Montenegrins as part of the broader Serbian national body and favors close political, cultural and religious ties with the country's northeastern neighbor.

title.en: Trump says he will speak to Taiwan's president in break from protocol

summary.en: It comes as the US weighs whether to proceed with a $14bn arms sales to Taiwan, which China claims as its own.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
US President Donald Trump says he will talk to Taiwanese leader Lai Ching-te about a possible arms sale, in what would be a sharp departure from diplomatic tradition.

US and Taiwanese leaders have not spoken directly since 1979 - when Washington severed formal ties with Taiwan to recognise the Chinese government in Beijing.

China claims Taiwan as its territory and has not ruled out taking it by force. The US has long supported the self-ruled island and is bound by law to provide it with a means of self-defence, but has balanced this with maintaining diplomatic relations with China.

As president-elect in 2016, Trump took a phone call from Taiwan's then leader Tsai Ing-wen, angering Beijing.

President Lai, who took office in 2024, is behind one of the strongest pushes in years to strengthen the island's defence.

When asked on Wednesday if he planned to speak to Lai ahead of making a decision on US arms sales, Trump said: "I'll speak to him. I speak to everybody.. we'll work on that, the Taiwan problem."

He also hailed his relationship with China's President Xi as "amazing", on the back of a two-day summit in Beijing last week.

When asked about the potential conversation between Trump and Lai, a Chinese foreign ministry spokesperson said on Thursday that China "firmly opposes official exchanges between the United States and Taiwan", as well as US arms sales to Taiwan.

China urges the US to "stop sending wrong signals to the separatist forces in Taiwan," the spokesperson said.

In 1979, the US passed the Taiwan Relations Act which states that the US can "provide Taiwan with arms of a defensive character" - which is why it continues to sell weapons to Taiwan.

Trump has said he has yet to decide if the sale of a $14bn (£10.4bn) arms package to Taiwan, reportedly including anti-drone equipment and air-defence missile systems, will go ahead.

According to a report by the Financial Times, Beijing is currently holding up a proposed visit by the Pentagon's top policy official, Elbridge Colby - saying it cannot approve a visit until Trump decides how he will proceed with the arms deal.

Last week, while flying back from Beijing on Air Force One after his meeting with President Xi, Trump was similarly asked about weapons sales to Taiwan, to which he said he would "make a determination over the next fairly short period".

"I have to speak to the person that right now is, you know who he is, that's running Taiwan," he said.

During Trump's visit to Beijing, China had made it clear that Taiwan was one of the biggest issues in its relationship with the US, with Xi warning of "conflict" between the two superpowers if handled poorly.

title.en: China says US should stop 'threats' against Cuba after ex-leader charged

summary.en: It comes after the US charged Cuba's ex-leader with murder, the latest move putting pressure on the regime.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
China has called on the US to stop using "coercion" and "threats" against its ally Cuba, after Washington indicted former leader Raúl Castro on murder charges.

An American court has accused the 94-year-old former president of conspiracy to kill US nationals over the 1996 downing of two planes, an incident which killed four people and fuelled diplomatic tensions between Washington and the Caribbean island.

US President Donald Trump has repeatedly sought to exert pressure on Cuba and has openly discussed toppling its communist regime.

On Thursday, Chinese foreign ministry spokesman Guo Jiakun said the US should "stop threatening force at every turn", and that Beijing "firmly supports Cuba".

On Wednesday, Castro was charged alongside five others of involvement in the shooting down of two planes travelling between Cuba and Florida three decades ago, and was indicted with offences which carry penalties of life in prison or death.

The aircraft, which were operated by the Cuban-American dissident group Brothers to the Rescue, were carrying three US citizens when they were downed, all of whom were killed.

At the time, Castro - who stepped down as president in 2018 - was head of the country's armed forces.

The incident caused outcry among Cuban exiles living in the US and has long been a source of contention between Washington and Havana.

Cuba's president Miguel Díaz-Canel has described the charges as "a political manoeuvre, devoid of any legal foundation".

The foreign minister of China, a long-standing supporter of Cuba, said Beijing opposed "any attempt by external forces to exert pressure on Cuba under any pretext".

Guo continued: "The United States should cease using sanctions and judicial apparatus as tools of coercion against Cuba and refrain from making threats of force at every turn.

"China resolutely supports Cuba in safeguarding its national sovereignty and dignity and opposes external interference."

The US has imposed new sanctions on the country and imposed a blockade on oil to Cuba, a move which has resulted in blackouts and food shortages.

Earlier this month, Trump signed an executive order sanctioning officials in Cuba's energy, defence, financial and security sectors, as well as individuals the US alleges have carried out human rights abuses or stolen public assets.

Since capturing former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro in January to face trial in the US over charges of narco-terrorism and drug trafficking, Trump has openly mused that Cuba is "ready to fall" .

China has become closer to Cuba since President Xi Jinping's 2014 visit to the island.

In 2018, Cuba joined China's Belt and Road Initiative, which funded several strategic infrastructure projects on the island.
body.zh: 在华盛顿以谋杀罪名起诉前领导人劳尔·卡斯特罗后，中国呼吁美国停止对其盟友古巴使用“胁迫”和“威胁”。 美国一家法院指控这位 94 岁的前总统因 1996 年击落两架飞机而密谋杀害美国公民，该事件导致四人死亡，并加剧了华盛顿与加勒比岛国之间的外交紧张局势。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普多次寻求对古巴施加压力，并公开讨论推翻其共产主义政权。 周四，中国外交部发言人郭家坤表示，美国应“停止动不动用武力威胁”，北京“坚定支持古巴”。 周三，卡斯特罗与其他五人一起被指控参与三十年前击落古巴和佛罗里达州之间的两架飞机，并被指控犯有终身监禁或死刑的罪行。 这架飞机由古巴裔美国持不同政见组织“救援兄弟”运营，坠毁时载有三名美国公民，三人全部遇难。 2018 年辞去总统职务的卡斯特罗当时是该国武装部队的负责人。 这一事件引起了居住在美国的古巴流亡者的强烈抗议，并长期以来一直是华盛顿和哈瓦那之间争论的根源。 古巴总统米格尔·迪亚斯-卡内尔将这些指控描述为“一种政治策略，缺乏任何法律基础”。 古巴的长期支持者中国外交部长表示，北京反对“外部势力以任何借口向古巴施加压力的任何企图”。 郭继续说：“美国应停止使用制裁和司法机构作为对古巴的胁迫工具，不要动不动就使用武力威胁。 中方坚决支持古巴维护国家主权和尊严，反对外部干涉。 美国对该国实施新的制裁，并对古巴实施石油封锁，此举导致停电和粮食短缺。 本月早些时候，特朗普签署了一项行政命令，对古巴能源、国防、金融和安全部门的官员以及美国指控侵犯人权或盗窃公共资产的个人进行制裁。 自从一月份逮捕委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗并因毒品恐怖主义和贩毒罪名在美国接受审判以来，特朗普公开表示古巴“已经准备好崩溃”。 自习近平主席2014年访问古巴以来，中国与古巴的关系更加密切。 2018年，古巴加入了中国的“一带一路”倡议，该倡议为古巴的多个战略基础设施项目提供了资金。

title.en: Taiwan: Trump prods China with offer of direct Taipei talks
title.zh: 台湾：特朗普提议与台北直接对话，以此刺激中国

summary.en: Donald Trump has indicated he would engage in direct talks with Taiwan's president regarding the purchase of US arms. This action would deviate from established diplomatic norms of over four decades and is expected to be perceived as a challenge by China.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将与台湾领导人就购买美国武器进行直接对话。此举将打破四十多年的外交惯例，并可能被中国视为一种冒犯。

body.en:
Donald Trump has said he will talk with Taiwan's president about purchasing US arms. The move would break over four decades of protocol and be an affront to China.

US President Donald Trump on Wednesday reiterated his intention to hold direct talks with Taiwan 's President Lai Ching-te over a reported $14 billion (€12 billion) arms deal — the first direct talks between the presidents of both countries in over four decades.

"I'll speak to him. I speak to everybody," said Trump when asked about the situation.

Taiwan's Foreign Ministry said on Thursday that Lai would be "happy to discuss these matters with President Trump."

It added that Lai is "committed to maintaining the stable status quo in the Taiwan Strait."

Trump's statement was the second such made since his state visit to China last week.

The US leader previously said he had "a great meeting" with Chinese President Xi Jinping , adding, "We'll work on that… the Taiwan problem."

The US officially shifted Taiwanese diplomatic recognition from Taipei (the Republic of China, or ROC) to Beijing (the People's Republic of China, or PRC) in 1979 as part of its "One China" policy of strategic ambiguity and has not engaged in public presidential communications with Taiwanese leaders since that time.

That same year, the US also established the Taiwan Relations Act, committing itself by law to providing Taiwan with the means to defend itself against regional threats.

Although the US has continued to engage in backchannel talks with Taiwan, public displays of support from Washington are frowned upon by Beijing, which considers the self-governing democracy part of its territory and has threatened to take the island republic by force if necessary.

During Trump's recent state visit, China's Xi made clear that the handling of the Taiwan issue would be key to maintaining stability in US-China relations, warning that missteps could lead to an "extremely dangerous situation."

Trump has suggested US arms sales could be used as a bargaining chip with Beijing on the issue.

A spokesperson for the Chinese Foreign Ministry urged Trump to "handle the Taiwan issue with extreme caution and stop sending wrong signals to the separatist forces of Taiwan independence."

Taiwan is heavily reliant on US arms to deter China and is eager to double down on the $11 billion deal approved by the Trump administration in December.
body.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，他将与台湾总统讨论购买美国武器的问题。此举将打破四十多年来的协议，是对中国的侮辱。 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周三重申，他打算与台湾总统赖清德就一项据报道价值 140 亿美元（120 亿欧元）的军火交易进行直接会谈，这是四十多年来两国总统之间的首次直接会谈。 当被问及情况时，特朗普说：“我会和他说话。我会和每个人说话。” 台湾外交部周四表示，赖清德将“很乐意与特朗普总统讨论这些问题”。 声明补充说，黎智英“致力于维持台湾海峡的稳定现状”。 这是特朗普自上周对中国进行国事访问以来第二次发表此类声明。 这位美国领导人此前曾表示，他与中国国家主席习近平进行了“一次精彩的会面”，并补充道，“我们将致力于解决台湾问题。” 作为其“一个中国”战略模糊政策的一部分，美国于 1979 年正式将与台湾的外交承认从台北（中华民国，简称 ROC）转向北京（中华人民共和国，简称中华人民共和国），并且从那时起就没有与台湾领导人进行公开的总统沟通。 同年，美国还制定了《与台湾关系法》，依法承诺为台湾提供防御地区威胁的手段。 尽管美国继续与台湾进行秘密谈判，但北京方面对华盛顿公开表示支持表示不满，北京认为自治民主是其领土的一部分，并威胁在必要时以武力占领这个岛国。 在特朗普最近的国事访问期间，中国国家主席习近平明确表示，处理台湾问题是维护美中关系稳定的关键，并警告说，失误可能导致“极其危险的局面”。 特朗普表示，美国的军售可以作为在这个问题上与北京讨价还价的筹码。 中国外交部发言人敦促特朗普“高度谨慎处理台湾问题，停止向台独分裂势力发出错误信号”。 台湾严重依赖美国武器来威慑中国，并渴望加倍落实特朗普政府去年 12 月批准的 110 亿美元协议。

reflection.en: International relations often involve navigating complex protocols and sensitivities to maintain stability. The biblical call to "live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on you," reminds leaders and nations of the ongoing responsibility to seek harmonious coexistence. Even when pursuing national interests, wisdom suggests considering the broader...
reflection.zh: 国际关系常需在复杂的礼仪和敏感性中航行，以维持稳定。圣经呼吁“若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦”，提醒领导人和国家有责任持续寻求和谐共存。即使在追求国家利益时，智慧也建议要考虑对全球和平与外交理解的更广泛影响。

verse.textEn: If it is possible, as far as it depends on you, live at peace with everyone.
verse.textZh: 若是能行，总要尽力与众人和睦。

title.en: Trump claims he will speak to Taiwan’s president, departing from decades-long diplomatic norms
title.zh: 特朗普声称将与台湾总统通话，打破数十年外交惯例

summary.en: Donald Trump announced his intention to speak with Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te, a move that would break decades of US diplomatic practice since Washington recognized Beijing in 1979 and could lead to significant international tension.
summary.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普宣布他打算与台湾总统赖清德通话，此举将打破自1979年华盛顿承认北京以来美国数十年来的外交惯例，并可能导致重大的国际紧张局势。

body.en: US and Taiwanese presidents have not spoken directly since Washington shifted diplomatic recognition to Beijing from Taipei in 1979 Donald Trump said on Wednesday he would speak to Taiwan’s President Lai Ching-te, an unprecedented move for a US leader that could roil US relations with China. “I’ll speak to him,” the US president told reporters at Joint Base Andrews in Maryland before boarding Air Force One when asked about Lai. “I speak to everybody … We’ll work on that, the Taiwan problem.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 自1979年华盛顿从台北转而与北京建立外交关系以来，美国和台湾总统就没有直接说过话。唐纳德·特朗普周三表示，他将与台湾地区领导人赖清德通话，这对美国领导人来说是史无前例的举动，可能会扰乱美国与中国的关系。当被问及赖智时，美国总统在登上空军一号之前在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地对记者说：“我会和他谈谈。” “我对每个人都说过……我们将致力于解决台湾问题。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: Major diplomatic shifts, especially those departing from long-standing norms, carry significant weight for international stability. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that a nation's well-being often depends on wise counsel and careful guidance. In complex global affairs, seeking broad wisdom can help navigate potential challenges and foster peaceful relations.
reflection.zh: 重大的外交转变，特别是那些偏离长期惯例的举动，对国际稳定具有重要影响。箴言11:14提醒我们，国家的福祉往往取决于明智的忠告和审慎的指导。在全球复杂的事务中，寻求广泛的智慧有助于应对潜在挑战并促进和平关系。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Nvidia’s revenue blows past Wall Street expectations as AI boom accelerates
title.zh: 英伟达营收远超华尔街预期，人工智能热潮加速发展

summary.en: Nvidia's revenue surpassed Wall Street's expectations, reinforcing investor confidence in the accelerating AI boom and its global expansion.
summary.zh: 英伟达的收入超出华尔街预期，进一步增强了投资者对人工智能（AI）热潮及其全球扩张的信心。

body.en: Many analysts view company’s financial performance as a broader referendum on AI buildout Nvidia continued its years-long streak of beating Wall Street’s expectations for growth on Wednesday, reassuring most investors that the AI boom, particularly the global explosion of datacenters, will continue apace. “The buildout of AI factories – the largest infrastructure expansion in human history – is accelerating at extraordinary speed,” said Nvidia’s CEO, Jensen Huang, in a statement . “Agentic AI has arrived, doing productive work, generating real value, and scaling rapidly across companies and industries.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 许多分析师将公司的财务表现视为对人工智能建设的更广泛的公投周三，英伟达延续了多年来超出华尔街增长预期的势头，让大多数投资者放心，人工智能的繁荣，特别是全球数据中心的爆炸式增长，将继续快速发展。英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在一份声明中表示：“人工智能工厂的建设——人类历史上最大规模的基础设施扩张——正在以惊人的速度加速。” “代理人工智能已经到来，它可以做富有成效的工作，产生真正的价值，并在公司和行业中快速扩展。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid acceleration of the AI boom, reflected in Nvidia's financial success, highlights a remarkable increase in human knowledge and technological capability. This era of expanding information reminds us of ancient prophecies that spoke of a time when knowledge would increase.
reflection.zh: 英伟达的财务成功所反映出的人工智能热潮的迅速加速，凸显了人类知识和技术能力的显著增长。这个信息不断扩展的时代，让我们想起古老的预言，其中提到知识将会增加的时刻。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Rosenberg: Putin enjoys Xi's Chinese welcome but heads home without pipeline deal
title.zh: 罗森伯格：普京享受习近平的中国式欢迎，但回国时未达成管道协议

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin visited China, where he was welcomed by President Xi Jinping. Despite a show of unity on the world stage, the visit concluded without a major pipeline deal, indicating limits to the partnership, according to the BBC's Russia Editor.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京访问中国，受到习近平主席的欢迎。据英国广播公司俄罗斯编辑报道，尽管两国在世界舞台上展现了团结，但此次访问并未达成重要的天然气管道协议，这表明两国伙伴关系存在局限。

body.en:
As Vladimir Putin and Xi Jinping walked the red carpet towards the Great Hall of the People, a Chinese military band played the romantic Russian classic Moscow Nights.

It was the language of two leaders who like to show they've built a special relationship. They have had plenty of time to do so: they have met more than 40 times over the years.

In their public statements they spoke of "strategic co-operation" between their nations, about "partnership", "mutual respect", "friendship" and "trust."

Together they railed against the "irresponsible" nuclear policy of the United States and condemned Donald Trump's plan for a Golden Dome missile defence shield.

On the eve of the visit the Russian government newspaper had published two big photos on its front page: one of a lonely-looking Trump climbing the steps of Air Force One at the end of his China trip last week; and beside it an old image of Putin and Xi walking together.

The visual messaging was unmistakable: Russia and China are shoulder-to- shoulder on the world stage.

And in the world of geopolitics relationships are rarely based on love and affection. It's often self-interest.

Russia is keen to push ahead with plans for a new pipeline, Power of Siberia 2, and had hoped for progress in Beijing. The pipeline would bring additional volumes of Russian gas from Western Siberia to Northern China via Mongolia and, for Moscow, help make up for the loss of European markets.

Last year Russia and China had signed a memorandum of understanding on the project, but Beijing appears in no rush to do the deal. As well as pricing issues, some commentators believe China wants to avoid over-dependence on Russian fossil fuels.

On Wednesday the Kremlin said Russia and China had reached a "general understanding on the parameters" of the project.

"The positions of Russia and China are not identical. Their interests do not always coincide," the Russian government newspaper had conceded: the same edition that had published the photo of Putin and Xi side-by-side.

"With two countries of this size, both with a great-power psyche, it couldn't be any other way."

It wasn't so long ago that the word "bromance" was being applied to another high-level relationship: this time Putin-Trump, as Russia and America pledged to thaw ties.

After the two presidents met in Alaska last summer Russian officials began referring to "the spirit of Anchorage" and hinting that Moscow and Washington had reached a mutual understanding on how to end the war in Ukraine (on terms acceptable to Moscow).

"The spirit of Beijing exists," Putin's foreign policy aide Yuri Ushakov said on the sidelines of the summit.
body.zh: 当弗拉基米尔·普京和习近平走上红地毯走向人民大会堂时，中国军乐队演奏了浪漫的俄罗斯经典《莫斯科之夜》。 这是两位领导人想要表明他们已经建立了特殊关系的语言。他们有充足的时间这样做：这些年来他们已经会面了 40 多次。 他们在公开声明中谈到了两国之间的“战略合作”、“伙伴关系”、“相互尊重”、“友谊”和“信任”。 他们共同谴责美国“不负责任”的核政策，并谴责唐纳德·特朗普的金顶导弹防御系统计划。 访问前夕，俄罗斯政府报纸在头版刊登了两张大照片：一张是特朗普上周结束中国之行时，一脸孤独地爬上空军一号的台阶；一张是特朗普在访问中国期间，一脸孤独地爬上空军一号的台阶；一张是特朗普在中国访问结束后，一脸孤独地爬上空军一号的台阶；一张是特朗普在访问中国期间，一脸孤独地爬上空军一号的台阶。旁边是普京和习近平一起散步的老照片。 视觉信息是明确无误的：俄罗斯和中国在世界舞台上并肩作战。 在地缘政治世界中，关系很少是建立在爱和感情的基础上的。这往往是出于自身利益。 俄罗斯热衷于推进新管道“西伯利亚力量2号”的计划，并希望北京能够取得进展。该管道将​​把更多的俄罗斯天然气从西西伯利亚经蒙古输送到中国北部，对于莫斯科来说，有助于弥补欧洲市场的损失。 去年，俄罗斯和中国就该项目签署了谅解备忘录，但北京方面似乎并不急于达成协议。除了定价问题外，一些评论人士认为，中国希望避免过度依赖俄罗斯化石燃料。 克里姆林宫周三表示，俄罗斯和中国已就该项目的“参数达成总体谅解”。 俄罗斯政府报纸承认：“俄罗斯和中国的立场并不相同。他们的利益并不总是一致的。”该报纸还刊登了普京和习近平并肩的照片。 “对于两个如此规模的国家，都具有大国心态，没有其他办法了。” 不久前，“兄弟情谊”这个词还被应用于另一种高层关系：这次是普京与特朗普，俄罗斯和美国承诺解冻关系。 去年夏天两国总统在阿拉斯加会晤后，俄罗斯官员开始提及“安克雷奇精神”，并暗示莫斯科和华盛顿已就如何结束乌克兰战争达成了共同谅解（以莫斯科可接受的条件）。 “北京精神是存在的，”普京的外交政策助手尤里·乌沙科夫在峰会间隙表示。

reflection.en: The news highlights how even strong international alliances can face limits when national interests diverge. While leaders may project unity, the practicalities of specific deals often reveal underlying priorities. This reminds us that ultimate loyalties shape our actions, and nations, like individuals, often find themselves serving distinct "masters" when...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了即使是强大的国际联盟，当国家利益出现分歧时，也会面临局限。尽管领导人可能展现团结，但具体交易的实际情况往往会暴露出潜在的优先事项。这提醒我们，最终的忠诚塑造着我们的行动，国家和个人一样，在经济或战略利益面前，常常会发现自己侍奉着不同的“主人”。

verse.textEn: No one can serve two masters... You cannot serve both God and Mammon.
verse.textZh: 一个人不能事奉两个主……你们不能又事奉神，又事奉玛门。

title.en: German authorities arrest 2 on China high-tech espionage allegations
title.zh: 德国当局逮捕两名涉嫌为中国从事高科技间谍活动的人员

summary.en: Two Munich residents have been arrested on suspicion of working for a Chinese intelligence service, seeking to obtain and pass on high-tech information with "military applications."
summary.zh: 慕尼黑两名居民因涉嫌为中国情报机构工作而被捕，他们被指控试图获取并传递具有“军事用途”的高科技信息。

body.zh: 两名慕尼黑居民因涉嫌为中国情报部门工作、试图获取并传递具有“军事应用”的高科技信息而被捕。 联邦检察官办公室 (Generalbundesanwaltschaft) 表示，调查人员周三逮捕了两名慕尼黑居民，罪名是涉嫌为中国从事间谍活动。 犯罪嫌疑人是一对德国公民夫妇，分别为Xuejun C.和Hua S.。 检察官称，这两人涉嫌为中国秘密情报机构工作。 检察官写道：“为了获得有关军事应用高科技技术的科学信息，他们与德国大学和研究机构的众多科学家建立了联系。” 他们特别注重与“航空航天和太空旅行、信息技术和人工智能领域的大学教授”建立联系。 据称，他们还冒充翻译员和一家德国汽车零部件供应商的员工以获得访问权限。 检察官称，“一些科学家被引诱到中国，是为了向平民听众提供讲座以获取报酬”。 “实际上，这些演示是在相关国营武器公司面前进行的。” 这两个人于周三根据一周前发出的逮捕令被捕。 联邦检察官与巴伐利亚当局合作。 周三晚些时候，这对夫妇被带到卡尔斯鲁厄联邦法院 (Bundesgerichtshof)，以就调查拘留做出决定。 巴伐利亚州、巴登-符腾堡州、柏林、勃兰登堡州、下萨克森州和北莱茵-威斯特法伦州也开展了与逮捕有关的进一步行动。 这些旨在与没有犯罪嫌疑的证人建立联系。 不要让算法隐藏新闻。如果您信赖我们团队提供的可信报道，请花点时间点击此处并点击“星标”或“首选”按钮，将我们选为您在 Google 上的首选来源，以便您始终能够首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

reflection.en: News of alleged espionage reminds us that international relations often involve hidden struggles for advantage and sensitive information. The Bible suggests that our deepest struggles are not merely against human adversaries, but against underlying forces that fuel distrust and competition. This perspective calls us to pray for peace and integrity in global...
reflection.zh: 有关间谍活动的指控提醒我们，国际关系中常存在隐秘的利益争夺和敏感信息获取。圣经教导我们，我们最深层的争战并非仅与人对抗，而是与助长不信任和竞争的潜在势力争战。这一视角促使我们为全球事务中的和平与正直祷告，认识到世俗张力背后的属灵层面。

verse.textEn: For our struggle is not against flesh and blood, but against the rulers, against the authorities, against the powers of this dark world and against the spiritual forces of evil in the heavenly realms.
verse.textZh: 因我们并不是与属血气的争战，乃是与那些执政的、掌权的、管辖这幽暗世界的，以及天空属灵气的恶魔争战。

title.en: 'My dear friend': Putin and Xi praise partnership during talks in Beijing
title.zh: “我亲爱的朋友”：普京与习近平在北京会谈中赞扬伙伴关系

summary.en: While Russia faces economic and financial sanctions from other countries, China remains a prominent and loyal customer.
summary.zh: 尽管俄罗斯面临其他国家的经济和金融制裁，中国仍然是其重要的忠实客户。

body.en:
Russian President Vladimir Putin has lauded his close ties with Chinese leader Xi Jinping, saying the nations are partners in trade and international affairs during bilateral talks in Beijing.

Xi welcomed Putin with a ceremony at the Great Hall of the People only days after meeting United States President Donald Trump.

The quick succession of Trump's and Putin's visits highlighted China's growing role as an international superpower, experts say.

Putin greeted Xi warmly as they met for the bilateral talks, describing the Chinese president as a "dear friend".

"We are truly delighted to see you. We keep in constant touch, both personally and through our aides in the government," he said.

Xi also stressed the "political mutual trust and strategic co-operation" between the countries, according to Chinese state media.

The two leaders have praised each other profusely in the past — Xi once describing Putin as his "best and most intimate friend".

Xi and Putin were set to focus on energy and security as well as their overall ties.

Chinese state media reported both parties agreed to extend a friendship treaty first signed in 2001.

China became Russia's top trading partner after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

China has said it is neutral in the conflict, maintaining trade ties with Russia despite economic and financial sanctions against Russia by the US and Europe.

China is the top customer for Russian oil and gas supplies, and Russia expects the war in Iran to increase the demand.

"The driving force behind economic co-operation is Russian-Chinese collaboration in the energy sector," Putin said.

"Amid the crisis in the Middle East, Russia continues to maintain its role as a reliable supplier of resources, while China remains a responsible consumer of these resources."

Xi stressed the need for the "complete cessation of hostilities" in the Middle East, according to Chinese state media.

"An early end to the conflict will help reduce disruptions to energy supply stability, the smooth flow of industrial and supply chains, and international trade order," Xi said.

A Russian presidential aide said earlier that Russia's oil exports to China grew by 35 per cent in the first quarter of 2026. Russia was also one of the biggest exporters of natural gas to China.

Putin said China and Russia's co-operation in foreign policy is "one of the key stabilising factors on the international stage".

In February 2022, just weeks before Russia invaded Ukraine, China and Russia announced a "no limits" partnership during a trip by Putin to Beijing.

title.en: EV battery supply chains in focus as China halts sulphuric acid exports

summary.en: China's decision to stop exporting sulphuric acid is expected to create pressure on global supply chains for both electric vehicle batteries and fertilizers.
